target: Next observation-interval total-storage change under prescribed-head lower-boundary forcing.
predictor_class: Separate standardized ordinary least-squares information probe per material and representation; intercept included; no regularization or hyperparameter tuning.
training_domain: Transitions with prescribed-head bottom mode in the next interval; first memory-unavailable transition excluded.
role: Candidate-family and coefficient derivation only. Training performance is not scientific validation and cannot select away any of the four frozen P8B candidates.
